integrity: Proof and 174 finite numerical assertions are supplied. The numerical tests are not a proof of the all-parameter theorem. Publication priority and independent scientific validation are not certified.
scientific_limitations: Two resources, uniform one-dimensional nonatomic population, strict interior threshold, C^3 coordinatewise monotone congestion, logistic/Gumbel noise. The expansions are local as noise approaches zero; no claim for nonuniform demand laws, boundary thresholds, nonsmooth costs, or more than two resources.
title: Opposite quadratic mass and demand shifts under low-noise congestion choice
